name: Emoji & Icon Studio by Kairesh
releaseNotes:
v2.8.3 Native Drag & Drop, Double-Click Insert & Clear All Recents!
• Native Drag & Drop: Full Adobe CEP protocol (com.adobe.cep.dnd.file.0) for dragging assets directly into Premiere Pro Timeline, bins, and After Effects!
• Instant Double-Click: Double-click any emoji, icon, or local file to instantly insert it into your active Comp / Timeline with zero dialogs!
• Clear All Recents: One-click "Clear All" button in Recents toolbar to easily reset your recent history!
• Synchronous File Generator: Instant zero-latency rendering of vector SVGs and crisp PNGs so drag payloads never fail or show forbidden cursors!
• Fixed child drag interception so dragging cards is smooth and seamless across all platforms.
